NeverOutOfPrint_BookUnsettles: Neutral third segment `lu lectaire`: -eur/-euse -> -aire, same pattern as `lu portaire` (porteur/porteuse) already used by another mod of this project; `lectaire` is the attested neutral of lecteur/lectrice (fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/lectaire, Alpheratz model), `lu` the al neutral article.
NeverOutOfPrint_NamelessBeliever: Fallback when the game supplies no ideoligion (no pawn, no gender): epicene invariable noun `fidèle` instead of the former point-median form.
NeverOutOfPrint_Namer_IdeoligionBook.rul: Two titles reworded to the plural (`Réponse des ...`, `Lettres aux jeunes ...`) so no gendered article or point-median mark is needed: the grammar resolver cannot know the gender of a generated member name.
NeverOutOfPrint_Description_IdeoligionBo: Argument line reworded to the plural (`entre des ... et des sceptiques, où les sceptiques ont le dessous`), same reason.
